title: The Crooked Crown Revisited
author: S. M. Hartwell
blurb: Kestrel Ishikawa, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
